description: This file defines the 'RingRange' struct, which models a contiguous range on a ring, typically used in distributed hashing or consistent hashing scenarios. It includes properties and methods for range creation, containment checks, intersection, difference, and serialization details specific to ring-based ranges.

classes.name: RingRange
classes.description: An immutable struct representing a range on a ring (modulo space), with support for full coverage, emptiness, wrapping, and range operations.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the range in unit space, accounting for wrapping.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a given point or GrainId is within the range.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares a point against the range boundary positions for ordering.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Computes the set difference of this range minus another range.
